verdict.rationale: Notte's own Functions feature deploys browser automations as serverless endpoints that can be invoked and scheduled, so actions can run automatically on a time-based trigger. However, there is no evidence of user-defined rules or event-driven triggers such as page changes, incoming emails, or webhooks. Missing for 10: a rule definition/condition engine, event-based triggers beyond scheduling, inbound webhook/event sources, detailed trigger documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
